evals.name: complete-design-review
evals.prompt: Create a Design Review / SRS in English from a linked PRD for a saved-payment experience. Include the system context, mobile app, payment backend, PSP token dependency, the technology profile (CSP and language preferences, Technology Radar outcome), API and event contracts, security/privacy constraints, p95 latency and availability targets, rollout and rollback, monitoring, and a Use Case index with UC-01 for selecting a saved card. The individual Use Case document will be written by another skill. Write Markdown to design-review.md.
evals.expected_output: A complete DR/SRS Markdown document with stable IDs, all always-required sections, a technology profile and Technology Radar outcome or explicit gap, relevant technical contracts and non-functional requirements, rollout/readiness information, and only a UC-01 catalog entry rather than a detailed Use Case body.
expectations: Uses the bundled DR/SRS template structure and includes the required sections.
Includes technical contracts, security/privacy, performance/availability, rollout/rollback, validation, monitoring, and readiness content.
Includes a technology profile with explicit preferences/constraints and the Technology Radar outcome or an explicit gap.
Creates a UC-01 index entry without generating trigger, flow, edge-case, or acceptance-check child content.
Preserves traceability to the PRD and other supplied source artifacts.

evals.name: incomplete-draft-with-visible-gaps
evals.prompt: Draft a Design Review for a collaboration workspace. The notes mention enterprise collaboration but do not confirm the owner, target users, scope of roles and audit logs, architecture, privacy review, availability target, or rollout strategy. Do not invent decisions. Produce a draft and make every material gap visible.
evals.expected_output: A draft DR/SRS that preserves uncertainty as assumptions/open questions or justified N/A values and does not fabricate owners, architecture, targets, compliance outcomes, or rollout decisions.
expectations: Keeps metadata.status as draft.
Makes missing ownership, scope, architecture, compliance, NFR, and delivery decisions visible.
Does not invent metrics, components, owners, or approval outcomes.
Uses N/A only with an explicit confirmed reason.

evals.name: accepted-rfc-requires-propagation
evals.prompt: Update the existing DR/SRS at design-review-rfc.md after RFC-07 was accepted to replace synchronous notifications with an event. The RFC page is linked, but its decision has not yet been propagated into the DR/SRS. Keep the operational document honest and identify the propagation work instead of silently treating the RFC as the current design.
evals.expected_output: The DR/SRS does not silently apply the RFC. It records the missing propagation, preserves the current operational behavior, and identifies affected contracts, Use Cases, tests, and backlog as follow-up work.
expectations: Treats the existing DR/SRS as the operational source of truth.
Does not apply RFC-07 behavior before propagation.
Records RFC-07 and the propagation gap in the decision/open-question area.
Identifies affected contracts and downstream artifacts without generating their implementation.

evals.name: use-case-catalog-link-first-and-readiness
evals.prompt: Author a new DR/SRS from the linked PRD at prd.md. Add UC-01 "Upload signed agreement" to the Use Case catalog; its child document is uc-01-upload-signed-agreement.md. Keep the DR/SRS as catalog only and link the child. Then assess whether the DR/SRS is ready for backlog generation: the child has a trigger and a main flow but no binary acceptance check.
evals.expected_output: A new DR/SRS from the PRD whose Use Case catalog row links the child document and carries the source artifact, priority, and status, with no detailed Use Case body; readiness is reported as not ready because a binary acceptance check is missing, with a gap and owner.
expectations: The catalog row links the child document and includes source artifact, priority, and status.
No trigger, flow, edge case, postcondition, or acceptance-check body appears in the DR/SRS.
Reports the missing binary acceptance check as a gap with an owner and does not claim readiness.
Does not invent acceptance checks.

evals.name: direct-intake-without-prd
evals.prompt: Crea una Design Review / SRS per un'iniziativa di hardening infrastrutturale. Non esiste un PRD né materiale di discovery: l'intake è una lista di attività: ruotare le credenziali del database, imporre mTLS tra i servizi interni e aggiungere un alert sulla scadenza dei certificati. Metti outcome e scope nella DR/SRS, lascia il JTBD collegato come non applicabile e non inventare un'esigenza di prodotto né bloccare il documento per l'assenza del PRD. Scrivi Markdown in design-review.md.
evals.expected_output: A DR/SRS whose visible content is in Italian, with references.prd marked N/A — direct DR/SRS intake, the initiative outcome and scope placed in the Expected outcome section, Use Case entries whose linked JTBD is N/A, and no fabricated product need, KPI, or guardrail.
expectations: Writes visible content in Italian (session language) while keeping IDs and machine-facing values unchanged.
Marks references.prd as N/A — direct DR/SRS intake and satisfies ready.prd via outcome/scope in the DR/SRS.
Records Use Case entries with linked JTBD = N/A — no linked PRD.
Does not block the draft and does not fabricate product need, KPIs, or guardrails.

evals.name: stable-identifiers-and-change-propagation
evals.prompt: Normalize identifiers and handle two change situations. Two source documents both label different behaviors as UC-03 in the DR/SRS. The linked PRD is "PRD-pagamenti" and defines JTBD-01; note that PRD and JTBD are optional and may be absent entirely. (A) Pre-baseline, two sources contradict each other on the retention period. (B) The baseline is approved and a new decision materially changes the API response contract. Add a cross-cutting availability target and an API acceptance check for UC-05. Record outcomes in the open questions/decisions area.
evals.expected_output: The duplicate UC-03 is flagged as possible-duplicate/gap without renumbering; identifiers follow the canonical namespaces (PRD-pagamenti/JTBD-01, NFR-XX, AC-UC-05-YY); the pre-baseline contradiction becomes an open question/gap, not a Change Request; the post-baseline material change becomes a Change Request per DR-07 with propagation to contracts, Use Cases, and tests, without implementing it.
expectations: Flags the duplicate UC-03 as possible-duplicate/gap and never renumbers or reuses an ID.
Uses canonical ID namespaces (NFR-XX, AC-UC-XX-YY, PRD-xxx/JTBD-yy) and tolerates absent PRD/JTBD (N/A).
Pre-baseline contradiction produces an open question/gap, not a Change Request.
Post-baseline material change produces a Change Request per DR-07 with propagation to contracts, Use Cases, and tests, without implementing it.
